column1: # Unified phrase replacements — one file to fix misrecognitions everywhere.
#   symbol  — injects into punctuation + symbol_key grammars (commands & dictation)
#   word    — injects into dictate.replace_words (dictation text output)
#   command — injects into vocabulary list (available in captures)
# Symbols — these become recognized spoken forms for the character
# Commands — alternate spoken forms available in vocabulary captures
